title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 6: Satomi Yoshida
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．６ ～吉田里深～
overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 6: Yoshida Satomi is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Satomi Yoshida. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.
